Dispatch and retry cooldown stores have separate source-composed bounds48 each; these do not bound live tickets or stage metadata.
Focus/radius and per-scan caps are not a global envelope: completion callbacks, persistence neighbours, repairs and retries feed the same scheduler.
Unload retirement occurs after save ACK; it cannot be treated as guaranteed immediate reclamation under save veto.
Non-Absent stage is written by focus truth sync, actual dispatch and lit-column promotion; current code also permits storing stage before residency.
